RESPONSIBLE ENGINEERING

Trust begins with what technology actually does.

Technical claims matter most when their evidence, limitations and operational boundaries are clear.

01 / THE APPROACH

Evidence before promises

A recorded demonstration establishes certain operations were performed under observed conditions. A reproducible calculation establishes a numerical result under specified assumptions. Neither automatically proves universal reliability, profitability or production readiness.

02 / IN PRACTICE

Data and privacy boundaries

MUSITU products have distinct processing arrangements. The corporate site uses local discovery. The optional Ask MUSITU service requires an intentional request and only approved public sources. Existing Intelligence browser-local workspaces remain separate.

03 / THE APPROACH

Security-conscious engineering

Engineering work considers authorization, input validation, output safety, resilient failure behavior and appropriate system boundaries. Our engineering practices evolve through review, testing and documented improvements.

04 / IN PRACTICE

Responsible automation

Financial execution, billing, customer privileges and other consequential actions require authority distinct from the ability to compute or suggest an outcome.

05 / THE APPROACH

Improvement through evaluation

Tests and monitoring can reveal limitations. Findings must be recorded accurately and guide further correction rather than being recast as marketing achievements.

INCLUSIVE TECHNOLOGY

Technology should be accessible to more people.

MUSITU aims to make its corporate website understandable and usable across devices and interaction needs.

01 / THE APPROACH

Designed for access

Clear landmarks, readable typography, visible focus and semantic controls support navigation with a keyboard, pointer or assistive technology. Color and animation are never the only means of conveying essential information.

02 / IN PRACTICE

Motion and responsive layouts

The site respects reduced-motion settings and reflows to narrow screens. Complex diagrams such as the Ecosystem Atlas provide an equivalent structured text representation.

03 / THE APPROACH

Testing and improvement

The target is WCAG 2.2 AA. Automated checks are supplemented by manual review; a draft build must not claim independent conformance or certification.

04 / IN PRACTICE

Feedback

Report accessibility barriers to support@mftintelligence.com. Include the page address, the obstacle and relevant device or browser context without sharing secrets.

Send accessibility feedback

PRIVACY & DATA HANDLING

Clear information. Respectful data handling.

Information about website access, browser-local features and communication through MUSITU support.

Privacy information for this website

This notice covers the corporate information website. Linked MUSITU products may provide their own notices.

Coverage and website operator

This Privacy Policy covers the MUSITU corporate information website, its browser-local navigation features and correspondence sent to the corporate support address. MUSITU is the website operator and data controller for this corporate website. Service and correspondence address: Mhundwa Village, Seke, Mashonaland East, Zimbabwe. Product applications, external purchasing services and third-party destinations may have separate operators, privacy notices and terms. For privacy, legal, security or accessibility enquiries relating to this website, contact support@mftintelligence.com.

Information handled when you visit

Website hosting and security systems can process technical request information, including IP address, approximate network location, browser and device attributes, URL requested, request time, diagnostic and security-event records. Such information may be necessary to deliver pages, maintain availability, investigate abuse and secure the service. Browsing public corporate pages does not require an account or a visitor-submitted profile.

Browser-local features and storage

The website's theme preference is stored in browser session storage, which can be cleared by closing the session or clearing site data. Site search, the Navigator, product comparison, filters, the Ecosystem Atlas and the local Ask MUSITU guide operate on public data in the browser. These activities do not submit their search text or calculations to a MUSITU AI model in this website release. Hosting and browser services may still process normal page requests.

Cookies and security controls

The current corporate website code uses browser session storage for the theme preference and does not include advertising or behavioural-tracking scripts. Depending on the configured hosting and access protections, security or access-control cookies may be set by the infrastructure provider. These controls are separate from the browser-local discovery functions. Browser settings can be used to manage stored site data, although blocking essential security cookies may affect access to protected pages.

Enquiries and voluntary information

If you email support@mftintelligence.com, the message can contain your name, reply address, subject, contents, attachments and technical email headers. We use correspondence to read, route, respond to and document enquiries and to protect the communication channel. Sending an enquiry is optional; you can browse public pages without contacting us, but without a working reply address we may not be able to respond. Please do not include passwords, payment information, identification documents, medical details, children's data or unrelated sensitive records.

Purposes and lawful processing

Technical request information is processed for website delivery, service integrity and security. Correspondence is processed to handle communications you choose to send, to manage legitimate operational needs and, where applicable, to comply with legal obligations. MUSITU will process personal information only where permitted under applicable data-protection law, including consent where required, legal obligations and permissible legitimate interests that are not overridden by individuals' rights. We do not use unsolicited enquiry messages as permission to send unrelated direct-marketing messages.

Service providers and disclosures

Cloudflare services support website hosting, network security and email routing; Google-hosted mailbox services support incoming correspondence; Resend is used for authorised outgoing messages where configured. These providers may handle technical records or message data for their respective services. Information may also be disclosed to authorised personnel handling an enquiry, or where legally required. This corporate website does not operate a visitor account service, built-in checkout or live AI inference endpoint.

Retention and safeguards

Information is kept only for purposes for which it is needed. Operational criteria include the duration of a security or diagnostic need, handling and follow-up of correspondence, prevention of abuse, and any applicable recordkeeping or legal-claim obligations. The actual duration of provider-held logs and email records depends on the configured systems and lawful retention requirements. Reasonable organisational and technical safeguards are used to reduce unauthorised access and disclosure risks; no internet service can promise absolute security.

Your rights and contact choices

Subject to applicable law, you may ask whether your personal information is processed and request access, correction or deletion of inaccurate information, or object to processing. You may object free of charge to the use of your information for direct marketing. You can contact support@mftintelligence.com with a description of the request. We may need limited information to verify the request before making a change, and certain records may need to be retained where law permits or requires. You may also raise a concern with Zimbabwe's Data Protection Authority (POTRAZ).

International processing

The website and communication providers may operate infrastructure or process information in countries outside Zimbabwe. Such processing may be subject to cross-border transfer requirements under Zimbabwe's Cyber and Data Protection Act and other applicable rules. Any transfer must satisfy the safeguards or lawful exceptions that apply to the relevant processing arrangement.

Children and sensitive information

This corporate information website is not designed to solicit children's personal information or sensitive records. Please do not send such material by email. If information requiring special protection is received, it must be assessed under applicable law, including requirements concerning a parent or guardian where relevant.

External services and product information

A link to MUSITU Intelligence, an app listing, an educational product or another external website does not mean that this corporate Privacy Policy governs that destination. Read the privacy information provided by the destination before providing data or completing a transaction. No product purchase is completed by this corporate website itself.

Changes and privacy enquiries

This notice may be revised to reflect actual website features, service providers or legal requirements. Material changes should be reflected in the public version when released. For a privacy or security concern relating to this corporate website, contact support@mftintelligence.com.

01 / FLAGSHIP

Complex questions deserve more than confident answers.

MUSITU Axiom brings specialized mathematical operations into intelligent analytical workflows. It focuses on structured quantitative work whose inputs, methods and results can be examined.

THE TECHNOLOGY

The challenge and the approach

Financial appraisal, statistical analysis and optimization can depend on explicit assumptions and reproducible computation. Axiom investigates how natural-language workflows can connect to appropriate mathematical tools without confusing numerical correctness with the suitability of a real-world decision.

CAPABILITIES

Eight ways to approach complex work

Axiom's current connected registry covers more than financial examples. Explore the full operation directory below for precise functions and methods.

  • Arithmetic, symbolic algebra and calculus
  • Numerical methods, differential equations and interpolation
  • Statistics, probability and inference
  • Time-series analysis and Fourier transforms
  • Linear algebra and constrained optimization
  • Financial valuation, derivatives, portfolios and risk
  • Geometry, number theory, combinatorics and reference data
  • Cross-checks and interval-based verification

Finance & investment / WORKED AXIOM TUTORIAL

Evaluate an investment with NPV

Does a four-year project create value at a 10% discount rate?

21 November 2026 · Real Axiom execution · Synthetic inputs

Understand the problem

Compare an investment's cost today with its future cash receipts. Discounting converts future receipts into comparable present-value amounts. NPV sums the discounted cash flows and initial outlay.

Inputs and method

The hypothetical project costs 100,000 units immediately and returns 30,000, 40,000, 45,000 and 25,000 units at the ends of four years. The required return is 10% annually.

NPV = −100000 + 30000/1.10 + 40000/1.10² + 45000/1.10³ + 25000/1.10⁴.

View exactly what was sent to Axiom
{
  "cashflows": [
    -100000,
    30000,
    40000,
    45000,
    25000
  ],
  "rate": 0.1
}

Recorded result

NPV: +11,215.08 monetary units

Operation: finance.npv

Axiom independent decimal-discount recurrence verified; residual 2.08e-11. This result was recorded using MUSITU Axiom on 21 November 2026.

What the numbers mean

The positive result means that these assumed inflows exceed the initial investment after applying the assumed 10% discount rate. It does not settle real project risks, taxes, financing conditions or execution feasibility. Test alternate rates and delayed receipts.

Make a constrained allocation decision

How should two activities be allocated to maximise a simple score under three limits?

21 November 2026 · Real Axiom execution · Synthetic inputs

Understand the problem

Linear programming helps allocate scarce resources to activities while maximising or minimising a defined objective. The decision variables, limits and objective all need explicit units and a coherent business interpretation.

Inputs and method

Choose nonnegative activity levels x and y. Maximise score 3x+2y, with capacity limits x+y ≤ 4, x ≤ 2 and y ≤ 3. Axiom solves minimisation, so the supplied objective c = [-3,-2] converts this into the equivalent minimisation task.

Maximise 3x + 2y subject to x + y ≤ 4, x ≤ 2, y ≤ 3, x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0.

    -2

The optimum is x=2 and y=2, producing a score of 10. Constraints x+y=4 and x=2 bind, while y≤3 does not. Axiom returned a solver-success status and independent primal–dual verification with zero duality gap. A real operations plan requires more realistic constraints and costs.
